challenge.method: Resolve which name the imperative classification modifies and check the direction of extension against the authors' description of their changes.
challenge.results: The classification attaches to ISETL. The authors then describe adding bag facilities to ISETL, confirming ISETL-LINDA as the extension.

limitations: The proposed identity concerns the documented ISETL notation. The same name also refers to interactive implementation material.
The York abstract supports the language usage here. ISETL implementation genealogy and a SETL parent relation require their own claim and scope.
